answer: Randomized witness panels. Each agent is assigned to a panel via a public verifiable random function; assignment is unpredictable until the round seed is revealed, so clones cannot precompute placement. A cipher commits each member's vote before the seed opens. Colluding clones must land on the same panel, and each sybil identity pays full registration and participation cost across a tundra of rounds to raise its odds. The trellis of overlapping panels makes capture cost scale superlinearly.
